01

A community marketplace

GloboExpats is a marketplace built around the expat community in Tanzania, bringing goods, services, homes, vehicles, and community requests into one browsing experience.

02

My contribution

My contribution is mainly frontend development. I work on the part of the product people navigate: turning platform features and data into interfaces that make sense together.

03

Frontend decisions

A marketplace has a lot to communicate at once. Categories, listings, seller information, and the next action all need enough space to be useful without competing for attention.

I approach that work through clarity and continuity: help someone understand what they are looking at, keep interactions predictable, and make the move from browsing to acting feel natural.

GloboExpats reflects the frontend side of my work: product interfaces connected to real services, with attention to both the broad journey and the small details along the way.
